description:
Title: Building a House

You want to build a tree house.
First you collect your requirements, and send them to a tree house architect.
The architect sends you back a draft, which you refine multiple times with additional requirements.
You then create the list of needed materials from the plan.
These materials fall into several categories, you order them from several online stores.
While the order is processed, you send messages to several of your friends to build the house.
After the house is built, you send invitations for a tree house party to your friends.
In order to buy the snacks for the party, a list of people that attend the party is created.

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrdersAndFriendsSplit" name="Process orders and contact friends"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProcessedOrder" name="Receive processed orders"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_OrdersAndFriendsJoin" name="Orders processed and friends contacted"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPartyInvitations" name="Send tree house party invitations"/>

    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine_SendAdditional" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SendAdditional_ReceiveDraft" sourceRef="Task_SendAdditionalRequirements" targetRef="Task_ReceiveDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptPlan" name="Plan accepted" sourceRef="Gateway_RefinementDecision" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Materials_Order" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialsList" targetRef="Task_OrderMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Order_Split" sourceRef="Task_OrderMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersAndFriendsSplit"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AskFriends" sourceRef="Gateway_OrdersAndFriendsSplit" targetRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveOrder_Join" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProcessedOrder" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersAndFriendsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskFriends_Join" sourceRef="Task_AskFriendsToBuild" targetRef="Gateway_OrdersAndFriendsJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_Build" sourceRef="Gateway_OrdersAndFriendsJoin" targetRef="Task_BuildHouse"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Invitations_AttendeeList" sourceRef="Task_SendPartyInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AttendeeList_End" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="End_AttendeeListCreated"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Architect" name="Prepare tree house draft" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_RequirementsReceived" name="Requirements received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Requirements" messageRef="Message_Requirements"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDraft" name="Prepare draft"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDraft" name="Send draft"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_DraftSent" name="Draft sent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Start_Prepare" sourceRef="Start_RequirementsReceived" targetRef="Task_PrepareDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Prepare_Send" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDraft" targetRef="Task_SendDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Architect_Send_End" sourceRef="Task_SendDraft" targetRef="End_DraftSent"/>
